module: GE extension `core_groundMarkerArrows`: manages the large floating arrows displayed at the intersections of the navigation route (model s_mm_arrow_floating.dae, TSStatic objects in the SimGroup 'arrowPool'). It is driven by core_groundMarkers (createArrowPool, updateArrows, clearArrows); a modder normally does not need to call it directly. It also displays the "wrong way" message when the vehicle moves away from the path.
notes: Pool of 11 arrows (loop 0..10), each represented by a proxy {pos, rot, state, wp, smoothers}. States: 'unused', 'visible', 'fadeout'. Arrows are placed 3.5 m above the intersection node, oriented toward the next point of the path.

An arrow is only created for a path point that is an intersection (linkCount > 2, with a wp node) located between 15 m (minArrowDistance) and 180 m (maxArrowDistance) ahead of the vehicle, and whose turn angle is greater than 25 degrees, or lower but not the smallest angle among the intersection's exits.
Size: 3 (arrowSmall) under 65 m, 4.5 (arrowLarge) beyond; slight forward offset when the arrow is under 45 m; fade in/out through temporal smoothing.
Color: read from core_groundMarkers.floatingArrowColor (the floatingArrowColor parameter of createArrowPool is unused).

Wrong way: a counter clamped to -20..20 increases when the vehicle's speed is opposite to the path direction (negative dot product) and decreases otherwise; above 0, ui_message 'ui.groundMarkers.wrongDirection' is displayed (5 s, id 'wrongDirection').
In photo mode (photoModeOpen) all arrows are hidden.
Inconsistencies: the floatingArrowColor parameter of createArrowPool is ignored; a large ImGui debug block is commented out in onPreRender; onExit is a simple alias of clearArrows.

createArrowPool.desc: Creates the SimGroup 'arrowPool' with 11 hidden TSStatic arrows (no collision, canSave = false) and their proxies. If the pool already exists, resets all proxies to 'unused' and hides the arrows.

updateArrows.desc: Updates the arrows from the path: creates/reuses those of the intersections to guide, fades out those that are no longer useful, and handles the wrong way message.

path.desc: Router path: elements {pos = vec3, distToTarget, wp, linkCount}.

pathLength.desc: Total distance from the vehicle to the destination in meters (distToVehicle = pathLength - path[i].distToTarget).

clearArrows.desc: Deletes all arrow objects and the SimGroup 'arrowPool', clears the tracking tables and resets the wrong way counter to -20.

onExit.desc: Engine exit hook: alias of clearArrows.

onPreRender.desc: Render hook: applies to each non-'unused' arrow its position, rotation and scale (smoothed size x alpha) and fades arrows to the 'unused' state once invisible. Hides everything in photo mode.
